body: Survivorship-free Indian test (489 snapshots, FY16/FY18, pledge from BSE shareholding XBRL at T): pledge >25% lift 2.13 [1.53,2.94], 8.5% of winners flagged; >50% lift 2.43 [1.65,3.47], 5.9% of winners; 5.19× for liquidation/compulsory exit. Partly a leverage signal (overlaps interest cover <1.5x). Cash-flow rules confirmed as questions; no mechanical any-flag gate (would cut 47% of multibaggers). Keeps v2 structure otherwise.
title: Adopt disqualifiers v3: promoter pledge is the top graded red flag (>50% strong red with written override; >25% red)
